answer: We anchor identity verification on a peer-attested trust graph where each thread of peer audits stakes collateral. Game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces stake slashing whenever topological cut verifications detect disconnected Sybil clusters bridging an authentic cluster to a spoofed wharf of fake identities. By identifying every sparse ridge between fraudulent cliques, the network forces superlinear attacker cost scaling with $O(N^{1.5})$.
